omissions: The agent's own sanity check reveals hire dates in 2026 (e.g. E006 hired 2026-09-25, E007 2026-06-01 in T0B6), which is suspicious for future dates, and the agent did not mention or assess whether these are valid hires; this does not change the 2025 count but was not flagged.
The agent did not verify the median against an independent method (e.g. recomputing with a second tool), though it did not claim to.
Median salary was computed on a joined dataset without checking for salary outliers or non-numeric salary values beyond the regex check; the final message does not note any such limitation.
